name: Bread
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: At night put in the bake dish 4 quarts warm water, 3 level tablespoons salt, 2 White Swan Yeast Cakes, mix all together with enough good flour to make a thin batter.
Next morning, when nice and light, put in 1 cup sugar, mix stiff and knead a few minutes, let rise and make into loaves.
Let them rise and bake in moderate oven for one hour.

source.originalInstructions:
1. At night put in the bake dish 4 quarts warm water, 3 level tablespoons salt, 2 White Swan Yeast Cakes, mix all together with enough good flour to make a thin batter.
2. Next morning, when nice and light, put in 1 cup sugar, mix stiff and knead a few minutes, let rise and make into loaves.
3. Let them rise and bake in moderate oven for one hour.
